display.purpose: Per-screen headlines and hero copy. Fraunces 28/1.2.

headline.purpose: Large title moments (About hero, empty-state heading). Fraunces 40/1.1.

title.purpose: Card titles, control labels, settings group titles. Inter 15 600.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, subtitles, helper text. Cap at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Section eyebrow labels (TRANSLATED TITLE, PROCESSING). Inter 11 600 1.5px uppercase.

mono.purpose: SRT bodies, log lines, file paths, engine names. JetBrains Mono 12/1.6.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft sunset halo under the primary CTA at rest (Init, idle Generate).

shadows.name: accent-glow-strong
shadows.purpose: Generate CTA when the form is ready — one step louder than the standard glow.

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: Modal, action sheet, toast, logs drawer. The only surfaces that earn a drop shadow.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Press feedback, card-hover lift, micro state changes.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Default for slide-up, fade-in, configure expand/collapse.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Larger transitions: processing card → result card swap.

motion.name: duration-slowest
motion.purpose: Page-level or stage transitions, rarely used.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Toggle thumb, button press release, scale-in on radio cards.

motion.name: preset-press
motion.purpose: Active-state press feedback on buttons and icon buttons.

motion.name: preset-card-hover
motion.purpose: Card hover lift; no shadow change.

motion.name: preset-stagger
motion.purpose: Sequential entrance for lists and grids.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Collapsed sidebar at 64px (icons only). Grid drops to 3-up.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Full 240px sidebar. Library grid 4-up. Content max-width 960px centered.

components.name: Text Input

narrative.overview: The app is a private screening room: dark walls, a single warm light, a serif title card before the picture rolls. Surfaces are matte-black at the base, lifted only by frosted glass panels. The single accent, a sunset orange, lives on the things you actually press. Everything else recedes into the dark. The viewer (someone curious about a video in a language they don't speak) reaches for the app the way they would reach for a remote. The system rejects four neighboring registers: SaaS dashboard, crypto/AI neon, enterprise software, and toy consumer app. The depth model is backdrop blur, not shadow. Type carries the personality: Fraunces serif for screen titles, Inter for the machine, JetBrains Mono for code and time.
keyCharacteristics: Single locked accent: sunset orange #fb923c, used on ≤10% of any screen.
Serif display moments (Fraunces 400), sans operating type (Inter), mono for time and code (JetBrains Mono).
Three glass elevation steps; no drop shadows on cards.
Dark theme only. Never #ffffff, never pure black on the foreground.
Animations ease out exponentially. No bounce, no elastic, no sparkle.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Sunset Orange is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point. If two items on a screen need accent, only one is actually load-bearing; the other should be glass-low or text-secondary.

rules.name: The Never-White Rule
rules.body: #ffffff is forbidden anywhere in the product. Text uses #f5f5f7 (Picture White); pure white jars against the dark glass surfaces.

rules.name: The Locked-Accent Rule
rules.body: #fb923c is the only accent. Do not introduce a second hue for novelty (no 'blue for info', no 'purple for premium'). Status colors are functional, not brand.

rules.name: The Fraunces-Only-For-Moments Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears in screen titles, hero copy, and the About page only. It never appears inside buttons, table rows, settings labels, or body paragraphs. Weight is always 400.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any monospace number in a column carries font-feature-settings: 'tnum'. Columns must align without the eye fighting the type.

rules.name: The 75ch Body Rule
rules.body: Body paragraph lines cap at 65–75ch. Anything wider becomes unreadable on the dark surface.

rules.name: The No-Shadow-On-Cards Rule
rules.body: Glass cards never carry drop shadows. The backdrop-filter IS the elevation system. Shadows on cards turn the dark theme heavy.

rules.name: The Glow-As-Affordance Rule
rules.body: Accent glow appears only on actionable CTAs at rest. It is a 'this is the next button you'll press' signal, not decoration. If three buttons wear a glow, none of them do.

dos: Do use #fb923c (Sunset Orange) as the only accent. Status colors are functional, not brand.
Do use Fraunces at weight 400 only, for screen titles and hero moments. Set negative letterspacing at display sizes (-0.5 to -1.5px).
Do use backdrop-filter: blur(...) saturate(...) plus a 1px translucent border on glass surfaces. The blur IS the elevation.
Do apply font-feature-settings: 'tnum' to every monospace number in a column.
Do give every focusable element a visible 2px accent border and 0 0 0 3px accentSoft ring on focus.
Do keep accent coverage on any screen at ≤10%.
Do consume glassRecipes.low/mid/high from @yt-subtitle-maker/ui instead of recreating blur values inline.
donts: Don't use #ffffff anywhere. Text is #f5f5f7 (Picture White).
Don't use Fraunces for body, buttons, table cells, or filler.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent. The sidebar active state is the one sanctioned exception (a 3px accent bar inside an accentSoft background).
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient to headlines. Emphasis is weight or scale, never gradient text.
Don't add drop shadows to glass cards.
Don't introduce a second accent hue.
Don't reach for a modal as the first thought. Exhaust inline expansion and progressive disclosure first.
Don't ship the generic SaaS dashboard look (hero-metric templates, identical card grids, Linear-clone chrome, gradient text).
Don't ship the crypto / AI-startup neon look (cyan-on-black, glowing gradient edges, sci-fi grid).
Don't ship the heavy enterprise software look (dense checkbox forms, native OS chrome, beige FFmpeg-GUI energy).
Don't ship the toy / playful consumer app look (rainbow gradients, oversized cartoon roundness, Duolingo-doodle warmth).
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use transform and opacity. Ease out with exponential curves. No bounce, no elastic.
